paragraphs.en: nvm is a version manager for node.js , designed to be installed per-user, and invoked per-shell. nvm works on any POSIX-compliant shell (sh, dash , ksh , zsh , bash ), in particular on these platforms: unix, macOS , and Windows WSL .
paragraphs.zh: nvm 是一个 node.js 的版本管理器，设计为按用户安装、按 shell 调用。nvm 可在任何符合 POSIX 标准的 shell（sh、dash、ksh、zsh、bash）上运行，尤其支持以下平台：unix、macOS 和 Windows WSL。

paragraphs.en: The installer can use git , curl , or wget to download nvm , whichever is available.

paragraphs.en: You can instruct the installer to not edit your shell config (for example if you already get completions via a zsh nvm plugin ) by setting PROFILE=/dev/null before running the install.sh script. Here's an example one-line command to do that: PROFILE=/dev/null bash -c 'curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.40.8/install.sh | bash'

paragraphs.en: When invoking bash as a non-interactive shell, like in a Docker container, none of the regular profile files are sourced. In order to use nvm , node , and npm like normal, you can instead specify the special BASH_ENV variable, which bash sources when invoked non-interactively.
paragraphs.zh: 当以非交互式 shell 的方式调用 bash 时（例如在 Docker 容器中），常规的 profile 文件都不会被加载。 为了能像平常一样使用 nvm、node 和 npm，你可以改为指定特殊的 BASH_ENV 变量，bash 在以非交互方式被调用时会加载该变量所指向的文件。

paragraphs.en: FROM ubuntu:latest ARG NODE_VERSION=20 # install curl RUN apt update && apt install curl -y # install nvm RUN curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.40.8/install.sh | bash # set env ENV NVM_DIR= "${HOME:-/root}/.nvm" # install node RUN bash -c "source $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh && nvm install $NODE_VERSION" # set ENTRYPOINT for reloading nvm-environment ENTRYPOINT [ "bash" , "-c" , "source $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh && exec \" $@ \" " , "--" ] # set cmd to bash CMD [ "/bin/bash" ] This example defaults to installation of nodejs version 20.x.y. paragraphs.en: If you get nvm: command not found after running the install script, one of the following might be the reason:

paragraphs.en: Since macOS 10.15, the default shell is zsh and nvm will look for .zshrc to update, none is installed by default. Create one with touch ~/.zshrc and run the install script again.
paragraphs.zh: 自 macOS 10.15 起，默认 shell 是 zsh，nvm 会查找 .zshrc 来进行更新，但默认情况下并没有安装该文件。 使用 touch ~/.zshrc 创建一个，然后再次运行安装脚本。

paragraphs.en: If you use bash, the previous default shell, your system may not have .bash_profile or .bashrc files where the command is set up. paragraphs.en: Node has a schedule for long-term support (LTS) You can reference LTS versions in aliases and .nvmrc files with the notation lts/* for the latest LTS, and lts/argon for LTS releases from the "argon" line, for example. In addition, the following commands support LTS arguments:

paragraphs.en: Any time your local copy of nvm connects to https://nodejs.org , it will re-create the appropriate local aliases for all available LTS lines. These aliases (stored under $NVM_DIR/alias/lts ), are managed by nvm , and you should not modify, remove, or create these files - expect your changes to be undone, and expect meddling with these files to cause bugs that will likely not be supported.
paragraphs.zh: 每当您本地的 nvm 副本连接到 https://nodejs.org 时，它都会为所有可用的 LTS 版本线重新创建相应的本地别名。 这些别名（存储在 $NVM_DIR/alias/lts 下）由 nvm 管理，您不应修改、删除或创建这些文件——请预料到您的更改会被撤销，并且预料到对这些文件的擅自改动会引发可能不受支持的错误。

sents.en: Any time your local copy of nvm connects to https://nodejs.org , it will re-create the appropriate local aliases for all available LTS lines.
sents.zh: 每当您本地的 nvm 副本连接到 https://nodejs.org 时，它都会为所有可用的 LTS 版本线重新创建相应的本地别名。

sents.en: These aliases (stored under $NVM_DIR/alias/lts ), are managed by nvm , and you should not modify, remove, or create these files - expect your changes to be undone, and expect meddling with these files to cause bugs that will likely not be supported.
sents.zh: 这些别名（存储在 $NVM_DIR/alias/lts 下）由 nvm 管理，您不应修改、删除或创建这些文件——请预料到您的更改会被撤销，并且预料到对这些文件的擅自改动会引发可能不受支持的错误。

paragraphs.en: To get the latest LTS version of node and migrate your existing installed packages, use:
paragraphs.zh: 要获取最新 LTS 版本的 node 并迁移你已安装的软件包，请使用：

paragraphs.en: nvm install --reinstall-packages-from=current ' lts/* ' Migrating Global Packages While Installing If you want to install a new version of Node.js and migrate npm packages from a previous version:
paragraphs.zh: nvm install --reinstall-packages-from=current 'lts/*' 安装时迁移全局包 如果你想安装新版本的 Node.js 并从旧版本迁移 npm 包：

paragraphs.en: nvm install --reinstall-packages-from=node node This will first use "nvm version node" to identify the current version you're migrating packages from. Then it resolves the new version to install from the remote server and installs it. Lastly, it runs "nvm reinstall-packages" to reinstall the npm packages from your prior version of Node to the new one.
paragraphs.zh: nvm install --reinstall-packages-from=node node 此命令会先使用「nvm version node」来确定你要迁移软件包的当前版本。 然后它会从远程服务器解析出要安装的新版本并进行安装。 最后，它会运行「nvm reinstall-packages」，把你之前 Node 版本中的 npm 软件包重新安装到新版本中。

sents.en: nvm install --reinstall-packages-from=node node This will first use "nvm version node" to identify the current version you're migrating packages from.
sents.zh: nvm install --reinstall-packages-from=node node 此命令会先使用「nvm version node」来确定你要迁移软件包的当前版本。

sents.en: Then it resolves the new version to install from the remote server and installs it.
sents.zh: 然后它会从远程服务器解析出要安装的新版本并进行安装。

sents.en: Lastly, it runs "nvm reinstall-packages" to reinstall the npm packages from your prior version of Node to the new one.
sents.zh: 最后，它会运行「nvm reinstall-packages」，把你之前 Node 版本中的 npm 软件包重新安装到新版本中。

paragraphs.en: You can also install and migrate npm packages from specific versions of Node like this:
paragraphs.zh: 你也可以像这样从特定版本的 Node 安装和迁移 npm 包：

paragraphs.en: nvm install --reinstall-packages-from=5 6 nvm install --reinstall-packages-from=iojs v4.2 Note that reinstalling packages explicitly does not update the npm version — this is to ensure that npm isn't accidentally upgraded to a broken version for the new node version.
paragraphs.zh: nvm install --reinstall-packages-from=5 6 nvm install --reinstall-packages-from=iojs v4.2 请注意，显式重新安装软件包并不会更新 npm 版本——这是为了确保 npm 不会在新 node 版本中被意外升级到有问题的版本。

paragraphs.en: To update npm at the same time add the --latest-npm flag, like this:
paragraphs.zh: 同时更新 npm 时，请添加 --latest-npm 标志，如下所示：

paragraphs.en: nvm install --reinstall-packages-from=default --latest-npm ' lts/* ' or, you can at any time run the following command to get the latest supported npm version on the current node version:
paragraphs.zh: nvm install --reinstall-packages-from=default --latest-npm ' lts/* ' 或者，你可以随时运行以下命令，在当前 node 版本上获取最新受支持的 npm 版本：

paragraphs.en: nvm install-latest-npm If you've already gotten an error to the effect of "npm does not support Node.js", you'll need to (1) revert to a previous node version ( nvm ls & nvm use <your latest _working_ version from the ls> ), (2) delete the newly created node version ( nvm uninstall <your _broken_ version of node from the ls> ), then (3) rerun your nvm install with the --latest-npm flag.
paragraphs.zh: nvm install-latest-npm 如果你已经收到类似于 "npm does not support Node.js" 的错误，你需要 (1) 回退到之前的 node 版本（nvm ls & nvm use <你在 ls 中最新的_可用_版本>），(2) 删除新创建的 node 版本（nvm uninstall <你在 ls 中_损坏_的 node 版本>），然后 (3) 使用 --latest-npm 标志重新运行你的 nvm install。

paragraphs.en: --reinstall-packages-from is tied to nvm install . To migrate global npm packages between versions you already have installed, without (re)installing anything, nvm use the destination and run nvm reinstall-packages as a standalone command, pointing at the version you want to copy from :
paragraphs.zh: --reinstall-packages-from 与 nvm install 绑定。 要在已安装的版本之间迁移全局 npm 包，而无需（重新）安装任何东西，请用 nvm use 切换到目标版本，然后运行独立命令 nvm reinstall-packages，并指定要从中复制包的版本：

sents.en: --reinstall-packages-from is tied to nvm install .
sents.zh: --reinstall-packages-from 与 nvm install 绑定。

sents.en: To migrate global npm packages between versions you already have installed, without (re)installing anything, nvm use the destination and run nvm reinstall-packages as a standalone command, pointing at the version you want to copy from :
sents.zh: 要在已安装的版本之间迁移全局 npm 包，而无需（重新）安装任何东西，请用 nvm use 切换到目标版本，然后运行独立命令 nvm reinstall-packages，并指定要从中复制包的版本：

paragraphs.en: nvm use 22.22.2 nvm reinstall-packages 22.20.0 This reinstalls all global packages from 22.20.0 into the currently-active version ( 22.22.2 ). As with --reinstall-packages-from , the npm version itself is not changed.
paragraphs.zh: nvm use 22.22.2 nvm reinstall-packages 22.20.0 这会将 22.20.0 中的所有全局包重新安装到当前激活的版本（22.22.2）中。 与 --reinstall-packages-from 一样，npm 版本本身不会改变。

sents.en: nvm use 22.22.2 nvm reinstall-packages 22.20.0 This reinstalls all global packages from 22.20.0 into the currently-active version ( 22.22.2 ).
sents.zh: nvm use 22.22.2 nvm reinstall-packages 22.20.0 这会将 22.20.0 中的所有全局包重新安装到当前激活的版本（22.22.2）中。

sents.en: As with --reinstall-packages-from , the npm version itself is not changed.
sents.zh: 与 --reinstall-packages-from 一样，npm 版本本身不会改变。

paragraphs.en: If you've previously downloaded a node version (or it's still in the cache), you can install it without any network access using the --offline flag:
paragraphs.zh: 如果你之前下载过某个 node 版本（或它仍在缓存中），你可以使用 --offline 标志在没有网络连接的情况下安装它：

paragraphs.en: nvm install --offline 14.7.0 This resolves versions using only locally installed versions and cached downloads. It will not attempt to download anything. This is useful in air-gapped environments, on planes, or when you want to avoid network latency.
paragraphs.zh: nvm install --offline 14.7.0 此命令仅使用本地已安装的版本和缓存的下载来解析版本。 它不会尝试下载任何内容。 这在隔离网络环境、飞机上，或者当你想避免网络延迟时非常有用。

sents.en: nvm install --offline 14.7.0 This resolves versions using only locally installed versions and cached downloads.
sents.zh: nvm install --offline 14.7.0 此命令仅使用本地已安装的版本和缓存的下载来解析版本。

sents.en: It will not attempt to download anything.
sents.zh: 它不会尝试下载任何内容。

sents.en: This is useful in air-gapped environments, on planes, or when you want to avoid network latency.
sents.zh: 这在隔离网络环境、飞机上，或者当你想避免网络延迟时非常有用。

paragraphs.en: You can combine --offline with --lts to install the latest cached LTS version (as long as LTS aliases have been populated by a prior nvm ls-remote --lts ):
paragraphs.zh: 你可以将 `--offline` 与 `--lts` 结合使用，以安装最近缓存的 LTS 版本（前提是 LTS 别名已通过先前的 `nvm ls-remote --lts` 命令填充）：

paragraphs.en: nvm install --offline --lts Default Global Packages From File While Installing If you have a list of default packages you want installed every time you install a new version, we support that too -- just add the package names, one per line, to the file $NVM_DIR/default-packages . You can add anything npm would accept as a package argument on the command line.
paragraphs.zh: nvm install --offline --lts 安装时从文件安装默认全局包 如果你有一份每次安装新版本时都想安装的默认包列表，我们也支持这一功能——只需把这些包的名称逐行添加到文件 $NVM_DIR/default-packages 中即可。 你可以添加任何 npm 在命令行中能接受作为包参数的内容。

sents.en: nvm install --offline --lts Default Global Packages From File While Installing If you have a list of default packages you want installed every time you install a new version, we support that too -- just add the package names, one per line, to the file $NVM_DIR/default-packages .
sents.zh: nvm install --offline --lts 安装时从文件安装默认全局包 如果你有一份每次安装新版本时都想安装的默认包列表，我们也支持这一功能——只需把这些包的名称逐行添加到文件 $NVM_DIR/default-packages 中即可。

sents.en: You can add anything npm would accept as a package argument on the command line.
sents.zh: 你可以添加任何 npm 在命令行中能接受作为包参数的内容。

paragraphs.en: # $NVM_DIR/default-packages rimraf object-inspect@1.0.2 stevemao/left-pad io.js Warning
paragraphs.zh: # $NVM_DIR/default-packages rimraf object-inspect@1.0.2 stevemao/left-pad io.js 警告

paragraphs.en: io.js was a fork of Node.js , created in 2014 and merged back in 2015. io.js shipped v1, v2, and v3 release lines; post-merge, node.js began releasing with v4.
paragraphs.zh: io.js 是 Node.js 的一个分支（fork），创建于 2014 年，并于 2015 年合并回 Node.js。io.js 发布了 v1、v2 和 v3 发布线；合并之后，node.js 开始以 v4 进行发布。

paragraphs.en: nvm install iojs If you want to install a new version of io.js and migrate npm packages from a previous version:
paragraphs.zh: nvm install iojs 如果你想安装新版 io.js 并从旧版本迁移 npm 包：

paragraphs.en: nvm install --reinstall-packages-from=iojs iojs The same guidelines mentioned for migrating npm packages in node are applicable to io.js.
paragraphs.zh: nvm install --reinstall-packages-from=iojs iojs 上面提到的关于在 node 中迁移 npm 包的相同准则同样适用于 io.js。

paragraphs.en: If you want to use the system-installed version of node, you can use the special default alias "system":
paragraphs.zh: 如果你想使用系统安装的 node 版本，可以使用特殊的默认别名 "system"：

nvm use system（使用系统版本）
nvm run system --version（使用系统版本运行）

paragraphs.en: nvm use will not, by default, create a "current" symlink. Set $NVM_SYMLINK_CURRENT to "true" to enable this behavior, which is sometimes useful for IDEs. Note that using nvm in multiple shell tabs with this environment variable enabled can cause race conditions.
paragraphs.zh: nvm use 默认不会创建 "current" 符号链接。 将 $NVM_SYMLINK_CURRENT 设置为 "true" 可启用此行为，这对某些 IDE 有时很有用。 请注意，在启用此环境变量的情况下，在多个 shell 标签页中同时使用 nvm 可能会导致竞态条件。

paragraphs.en: To pass an Authorization header through to the mirror url, set $NVM_AUTH_HEADER
paragraphs.zh: 要通过 Authorization 请求头传递到镜像 URL，请设置 $NVM_AUTH_HEADER

paragraphs.en: NVM_AUTH_HEADER= " Bearer secret-token " nvm install node The header is only sent with requests for URLs under a mirror, never to any other host. If exactly one of $NVM_NODEJS_ORG_MIRROR and $NVM_IOJS_ORG_MIRROR is set, only that mirror receives it; if both are set, both do; if neither is, the default mirrors ( https://nodejs.org/dist and https://iojs.org/dist ) do.

paragraphs.en: curl 7.58.0 and later, which nvm prefers, drops the header when the mirror redirects to another host. When only wget is available, nvm makes GNU Wget follow a redirect only if it stays on the same origin (scheme, host, and port), and fails on one that does not, since wget would send the header there too; use curl with a mirror that hands downloads off to another host. Other wget s, like BusyBox's, cannot be kept from following redirects, and send the header wherever the mirror redirects.
paragraphs.zh: nvm 更倾向于使用 curl 7.58.0 及更高版本，这些版本在镜像重定向到另一台主机时会丢弃该请求头。 当只有 wget 可用时，nvm 仅在 GNU Wget 的重定向保持同一源（协议、主机和端口）时才会让其跟随重定向，否则会失败，因为 wget 也会在该处发送请求头；若镜像将下载转交给另一台主机，请使用 curl。 其他 wget（如 BusyBox 的）无法被阻止跟随重定向，并且会将请求头发送到镜像重定向到的任何位置。

paragraphs.en: $NVM_AUTH_HEADER is the recommended way to authenticate to a mirror. Credentials embedded in the mirror URL itself ( https://user:password@host/... ) also work, and nvm prints such URLs with the credentials masked as ***@ .

paragraphs.en: You can create a .nvmrc file containing a node version number (or any other string that nvm understands; see nvm --help for details) in the project root directory (or any parent directory). Afterwards, nvm use , nvm install , and nvm which will use the version specified in the .nvmrc file if no version is supplied on the command line; if no .nvmrc is found either, they exit with status 127 . ( nvm exec and nvm run follow the same .nvmrc lookup, but currently fall back to the active node if neither resolves — treat that fallback as undefined behavior; pass an explicit version if you need predictable scripting.) If you want the currently active version, pass current explicitly (e.g. nvm which current ) — current is not affected by .nvmrc .
paragraphs.zh: 你可以在项目根目录（或任何上级目录）中创建一个包含 node 版本号（或任何 nvm 能识别的其他字符串；详见 nvm --help）的 .nvmrc 文件。 此后，如果在命令行中未提供版本号，nvm use、nvm install 和 nvm which 将使用 .nvmrc 文件中指定的版本；如果也找不到 .nvmrc，它们将以状态码 127 退出。 （nvm exec 和 nvm run 遵循相同的 .nvmrc 查找规则，但如果两者都未能解析出版本，目前会回退到当前活动的 node——请将该回退视为未定义行为；如需可预测的脚本执行，请显式传入版本号。）如果你想要当前活动的版本，请显式传入 current（例如 nvm which current）——current 不受 .nvmrc 影响。

paragraphs.en: For example, to make nvm default to the latest 5.9 release, the latest LTS version, or the latest node version for the current directory:

paragraphs.en: $ echo " 5.9 " > .nvmrc $ echo " lts/* " > .nvmrc # to default to the latest LTS version $ echo " node " > .nvmrc # to default to the latest version [NB these examples assume a POSIX-compliant shell version of echo . If you use a Windows cmd development environment, eg the .nvmrc file is used to configure a remote Linux deployment, then keep in mind the " s will be copied leading to an invalid file. Remove them.]

paragraphs.en: In your profile ( ~/.bash_profile , ~/.zshrc , ~/.profile , or ~/.bashrc ), add the following to nvm use whenever you enter a new directory:

paragraphs.en: Put the following at the end of your $HOME/.bashrc :
paragraphs.zh: 将以下内容添加到您的 $HOME/.bashrc 文件末尾：

paragraphs.en: cdnvm () { command cd " $@ " || return $? nvm_path= " $( nvm_find_up .nvmrc | command tr -d ' \n ' ) " # If there are no .nvmrc file, use the default nvm version if [[ ! $nvm_path = * [^[:space:]] * ]] ; then declare default_version default_version = " $( nvm version default ) " # If there is no default version, set it to `node` # This will use the latest version on your machine if [ $default_version = ' N/A ' ] ; then nvm alias default node default_version= $( nvm version default ) fi # If the current version is not the default version, set it to use the default version if [ " $( nvm current ) " != " ${default_version} " ] ; then nvm use default fi elif [[ -s " ${nvm_path} /.nvmrc " && -r " ${nvm_path} /.nvmrc " ]] ; then declare nvm_version nvm_version = $( < " ${nvm_path} " /.nvmrc ) declare locally_resolved_nvm_version # `nvm ls` will check all locally-available versions # If there are multiple matching versions, take the latest one # Remove the `->` and `*` characters and spaces # `locally_resolved_nvm_version` will be `N/A` if no local versions are found locally_resolved_nvm_version = $( nvm ls --no-colors " ${nvm_version} " | command tail -1 | command tr -d ' \->* ' | command tr -d ' [:space:] ' ) # If it is not already installed, install it # `nvm install` will implicitly use the newly-installed version if [ " ${locally_resolved_nvm_version} " = ' N/A ' ] ; then nvm install " ${nvm_version} " ; elif [ " $( nvm current ) " != " ${locally_resolved_nvm_version} " ] ; then nvm use " ${nvm_version} " ; fi fi } alias cd = ' cdnvm ' cdnvm " $PWD " || exit This alias would search 'up' from your current directory in order to detect a .nvmrc file. If it finds it, it will switch to that version; if not, it will use the default version.
paragraphs.zh: cdnvm () { command cd " $@ " || return $? nvm_path= " $( nvm_find_up .nvmrc | command tr -d ' \n ' ) " # 如果没有 .nvmrc 文件，则使用默认的 nvm 版本 if [[ ! $nvm_path = * [^[:space:]] * ]] ; then declare default_version default_version = " $( nvm version default ) " # 如果没有默认版本，将其设置为 `node` # 这将使用你机器上的最新版本 if [ $default_version = ' N/A ' ] ; then nvm alias default node default_version= $( nvm version default ) fi # 如果当前版本不是默认版本，则切换为使用默认版本 if [ " $( nvm current ) " != " ${default_version} " ] ; then nvm use default fi elif [[ -s " ${nvm_path} /.nvmrc " && -r " ${nvm_path} /.nvmrc " ]] ; then declare nvm_version nvm_version = $( < " ${nvm_path} " /.nvmrc ) declare locally_resolved_nvm_version # `nvm ls` 会检查所有本地可用的版本 # 如果有多个匹配的版本，取最新的一个 # 移除 `->` 和 `*` 字符以及空格 # 如果未找到本地版本，`locally_resolved_nvm_version` 将为 `N/A` locally_resolved_nvm_version = $( nvm ls --no-colors " ${nvm_version} " | command tail -1 | command tr -d ' \->* ' | command tr -d ' [:space:] ' ) # 如果尚未安装，则进行安装 # `nvm install` 会隐式使用新安装的版本 if [ " ${locally_resolved_nvm_version} " = ' N/A ' ] ; then nvm install " ${nvm_version} " ; elif [ " $( nvm current ) " != " ${locally_resolved_nvm_version} " ] ; then nvm use " ${nvm_version} " ; fi fi } alias cd = ' cdnvm ' cdnvm " $PWD " || exit 这个别名会从你当前目录向上搜索，以检测 .nvmrc 文件。 如果找到了该文件，它将切换到该版本；如果没有找到，它将使用默认版本。

paragraphs.en: # place this after nvm initialization! autoload -U add-zsh-hook load-nvmrc () { local nvmrc_path nvmrc_path= " $( nvm_find_nvmrc ) " if [ -n " $nvmrc_path " ] ; then local nvmrc_node_version nvmrc_node_version= $( nvm version " $( cat " ${nvmrc_path} " ) " ) if [ " $nvmrc_node_version " = " N/A " ] ; then nvm install elif [ " $nvmrc_node_version " != " $( nvm version ) " ] ; then nvm use fi elif [ -n " $( PWD= $OLDPWD nvm_find_nvmrc ) " ] && [ " $( nvm version ) " != " $( nvm version default ) " ] ; then echo " Reverting to nvm default version " nvm use default fi } add-zsh-hook chpwd load-nvmrc load-nvmrc After saving the file, run source ~/.zshrc to reload the configuration with the latest changes made.

paragraphs.en: nvm install <version> takes a per-version advisory lock (a directory under $NVM_DIR/.cache/locks ), so two shells installing the same version at once cannot corrupt its version directory; installs of different versions never block each other.

paragraphs.en: set -e Installing nvm on Alpine Linux In order to provide the best performance (and other optimizations), nvm will download and install pre-compiled binaries for Node (and npm) when you run nvm install X . The Node project compiles, tests and hosts/provides these pre-compiled binaries which are built for mainstream/traditional Linux distributions (such as Debian, Ubuntu, CentOS , RedHat et al).
paragraphs.zh: set -e 在 Alpine Linux 上安装 nvm 为了提供最佳性能（以及其他优化），当你运行 nvm install X 时，nvm 会下载并安装 Node（和 npm）的预编译二进制文件。 这些预编译二进制文件由 Node 项目针对主流/传统 Linux 发行版（如 Debian、Ubuntu、CentOS、RedHat 等）进行编译、测试并托管/提供。

sents.en: set -e Installing nvm on Alpine Linux In order to provide the best performance (and other optimizations), nvm will download and install pre-compiled binaries for Node (and npm) when you run nvm install X .

sents.en: The Node project compiles, tests and hosts/provides these pre-compiled binaries which are built for mainstream/traditional Linux distributions (such as Debian, Ubuntu, CentOS , RedHat et al).
sents.zh: 这些预编译二进制文件由 Node 项目针对主流/传统 Linux 发行版（如 Debian、Ubuntu、CentOS、RedHat 等）进行编译、测试并托管/提供。

paragraphs.en: Alpine Linux , unlike mainstream/traditional Linux distributions, is based on BusyBox , a very compact (~5MB) Linux distribution. BusyBox (and thus Alpine Linux) uses a different C/C++ stack to most mainstream/traditional Linux distributions - musl . This makes binary programs built for such mainstream/traditional distributions incompatible with Alpine Linux, so on x64 and arm64 nvm requests a musl build instead. nodejs.org publishes those only for some recent x64 releases, so for anything else the download 404s and nvm install X falls back to compiling from source, unless you point it at a mirror that has one (see Platforms without official binaries ).
paragraphs.zh: Alpine Linux 与主流/传统 Linux 发行版不同，它基于 BusyBox，一个非常紧凑（约 5MB）的 Linux 发行版。 BusyBox（因此也包括 Alpine Linux）使用与大多数主流/传统 Linux 发行版不同的 C/C++ 技术栈——musl。 这使得为主流/传统发行版构建的二进制程序与 Alpine Linux 不兼容，因此在 x64 和 arm64 上 nvm 会请求 musl 构建的版本。nodejs.org 仅为部分较新的 x64 版本发布此类构建，所以其他情况下下载会返回 404，nvm install X 将回退到从源码编译，除非你将其指向一个拥有该构建的镜像（参见 没有官方二进制文件的平台 ）。

paragraphs.en: If installing nvm on Alpine Linux is still what you want or need to do, you should be able to achieve this by running the following from your Alpine Linux shell, depending on which version you are using:
paragraphs.zh: 如果您仍然想要或需要在 Alpine Linux 上安装 nvm，那么根据您使用的版本，您应该可以通过在 Alpine Linux 的 shell 中运行以下命令来实现：

paragraphs.en: apk add -U curl bash ca-certificates openssl ncurses coreutils python3 make gcc g++ libgcc linux-headers grep util-linux binutils findutils curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.40.8/install.sh | bash Alpine Linux 3.5 - 3.12 apk add -U curl bash ca-certificates openssl ncurses coreutils python2 make gcc g++ libgcc linux-headers grep util-linux binutils findutils curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.40.8/install.sh | bash Note: Alpine 3.5 can only install NodeJS versions up to v6.9.5, Alpine 3.6 can only install versions up to v6.10.3, Alpine 3.7 installs versions up to v8.9.3, Alpine 3.8 installs versions up to v8.14.0, Alpine 3.9 installs versions up to v10.19.0, Alpine 3.10 installs versions up to v10.24.1, Alpine 3.11 installs versions up to v12.22.6, Alpine 3.12 installs versions up to v12.22.12, Alpine 3.13 & 3.14 install versions up to v14.20.0, Alpine 3.15 & 3.16 install versions up to v16.16.0 ( These are all versions on the main branch ). Alpine 3.5 - 3.12 required the package python2 to build NodeJS, as they are older versions to build. Alpine 3.13+ requires python3 to successfully build newer NodeJS versions, but you can use python2 with Alpine 3.13+ if you need to build versions of node supported in Alpine 3.5 - 3.15, you just need to specify what version of NodeJS you need to install in the package install script.

paragraphs.en: Experimental support for the Apple Silicon chip architecture was added in node.js v15.3 and full support was added in v16.0. Because of this, if you try to install older versions of node as usual, you will probably experience either compilation errors when installing node or out-of-memory errors while running your code.
paragraphs.zh: node.js 在 v15.3 版本中增加了对 Apple Silicon 芯片架构的实验性支持，并在 v16.0 版本中提供了完整支持。 因此，如果你照常尝试安装较旧版本的 node，可能会在安装 node 时遇到编译错误，或在运行代码时遇到内存不足的错误。

sents.en: Experimental support for the Apple Silicon chip architecture was added in node.js v15.3 and full support was added in v16.0.
sents.zh: node.js 在 v15.3 版本中增加了对 Apple Silicon 芯片架构的实验性支持，并在 v16.0 版本中提供了完整支持。

sents.en: Because of this, if you try to install older versions of node as usual, you will probably experience either compilation errors when installing node or out-of-memory errors while running your code.
sents.zh: 因此，如果你照常尝试安装较旧版本的 node，可能会在安装 node 时遇到编译错误，或在运行代码时遇到内存不足的错误。

paragraphs.en: So, if you want to run a version prior to v16.0 on an Apple Silicon Mac, it may be best to compile node targeting the x86_64 Intel architecture so that Rosetta 2 can translate the x86_64 processor instructions to ARM-based Apple Silicon instructions. Here's what you will need to do:
paragraphs.zh: 因此，如果你想在 Apple Silicon Mac 上运行 v16.0 之前的版本，最好编译针对 x86_64 Intel 架构的 node，这样 Rosetta 2 就能将 x86_64 处理器指令翻译为基于 ARM 的 Apple Silicon 指令。 以下是你需要做的事情：

sents.en: So, if you want to run a version prior to v16.0 on an Apple Silicon Mac, it may be best to compile node targeting the x86_64 Intel architecture so that Rosetta 2 can translate the x86_64 processor instructions to ARM-based Apple Silicon instructions.
sents.zh: 因此，如果你想在 Apple Silicon Mac 上运行 v16.0 之前的版本，最好编译针对 x86_64 Intel 架构的 node，这样 Rosetta 2 就能将 x86_64 处理器指令翻译为基于 ARM 的 Apple Silicon 指令。

sents.en: Here's what you will need to do:
sents.zh: 以下是你需要做的事情：

paragraphs.en: Install Rosetta, if you haven't already done so
paragraphs.zh: 安装 Rosetta（如果您尚未安装）

paragraphs.en: $ softwareupdate --install-rosetta You might wonder, "how will my Apple Silicon Mac know to use Rosetta for a version of node compiled for an Intel chip?". If an executable contains only Intel instructions, macOS will automatically use Rosetta to translate the instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 运行 $ softwareupdate --install-rosetta 你可能会好奇：「我的 Apple Silicon Mac 怎么会知道要为为 Intel 芯片编译的 node 版本使用 Rosetta？」 如果一个可执行文件只包含 Intel 指令，macOS 会自动使用 Rosetta 来翻译这些指令。

sents.en: $ softwareupdate --install-rosetta You might wonder, "how will my Apple Silicon Mac know to use Rosetta for a version of node compiled for an Intel chip?".
sents.zh: 运行 $ softwareupdate --install-rosetta 你可能会好奇：「我的 Apple Silicon Mac 怎么会知道要为为 Intel 芯片编译的 node 版本使用 Rosetta？」

sents.en: If an executable contains only Intel instructions, macOS will automatically use Rosetta to translate the instructions.
sents.zh: 如果一个可执行文件只包含 Intel 指令，macOS 会自动使用 Rosetta 来翻译这些指令。

paragraphs.en: Open a shell that's running using Rosetta
paragraphs.zh: 打开一个使用 Rosetta 运行的 shell

paragraphs.en: $ arch -x86_64 zsh Note: This same thing can also be accomplished by finding the Terminal or iTerm App in Finder, right clicking, selecting "Get Info", and then checking the box labeled "Open using Rosetta".
paragraphs.zh: $ arch -x86_64 zsh 注意：同样的事情也可以通过在访达（Finder）中找到终端（Terminal）或 iTerm 应用，右键点击，选择“显示简介”，然后勾选“使用 Rosetta 打开”复选框来完成。

paragraphs.en: Note: This terminal session is now running in zsh . If zsh is not the shell you typically use, nvm may not be source 'd automatically like it probably is for your usual shell through your dotfiles. If that's the case, make sure to source nvm .
paragraphs.zh: 注意：此终端会话现在正在 zsh 中运行。 如果 zsh 不是你通常使用的 shell，nvm 可能不会像在你的常用 shell 中那样通过 dotfiles 自动被 source。 如果是这种情况，请确保 source nvm。

sents.en: Note: This terminal session is now running in zsh .
sents.zh: 注意：此终端会话现在正在 zsh 中运行。

sents.en: If zsh is not the shell you typically use, nvm may not be source 'd automatically like it probably is for your usual shell through your dotfiles.
sents.zh: 如果 zsh 不是你通常使用的 shell，nvm 可能不会像在你的常用 shell 中那样通过 dotfiles 自动被 source。

sents.en: If that's the case, make sure to source nvm .
sents.zh: 如果是这种情况，请确保 source nvm。

paragraphs.en: $ source " ${NVM_DIR} /nvm.sh " Install whatever older version of node you are interested in. Let's use 12.22.1 as an example. This will fetch the node source code and compile it, which will take several minutes.
paragraphs.zh: $ source "${NVM_DIR}/nvm.sh" 安装你感兴趣的任意较旧版本的 node。 我们以 12.22.1 为例。 这将获取 node 的源代码并进行编译，此过程需要几分钟时间。

sents.zh: $ source "${NVM_DIR}/nvm.sh" 安装你感兴趣的任意较旧版本的 node。

sents.en: Let's use 12.22.1 as an example.
This will fetch the node source code and compile it, which will take several minutes.
sents.zh: 这将获取 node 的源代码并进行编译，此过程需要几分钟时间。

paragraphs.en: $ nvm install v12.22.1 --shared-zlib Note: You're probably curious why --shared-zlib is included. There's a bug in recent versions of Apple's system clang compiler. If one of these broken versions is installed on your system, the above step will likely still succeed even if you didn't include the --shared-zlib flag. However, later, when you attempt to npm install something using your old version of node.js, you will see incorrect data check errors. If you want to avoid the possible hassle of dealing with this, include that flag. For more details, see this issue and this comment
paragraphs.zh: $ nvm install v12.22.1 --shared-zlib 注意：你可能好奇为什么命令中包含 --shared-zlib。 这是由于 Apple 近期版本的系统 clang 编译器中存在一个 bug。 如果你的系统上安装了这些有问题的版本之一，即使没有加 --shared-zlib 标志，上述步骤可能仍然会成功。 然而，之后当你尝试使用旧版本的 node.js 执行 npm install 安装某些东西时，你会看到错误的数据校验错误。 如果你想避免处理这个问题可能带来的麻烦，请加上该标志。 更多详情，请参见这个 issue 和这条评论

sents.en: $ nvm install v12.22.1 --shared-zlib Note: You're probably curious why --shared-zlib is included.
sents.zh: $ nvm install v12.22.1 --shared-zlib 注意：你可能好奇为什么命令中包含 --shared-zlib。

sents.en: There's a bug in recent versions of Apple's system clang compiler.
sents.zh: 这是由于 Apple 近期版本的系统 clang 编译器中存在一个 bug。

sents.en: If one of these broken versions is installed on your system, the above step will likely still succeed even if you didn't include the --shared-zlib flag.
sents.zh: 如果你的系统上安装了这些有问题的版本之一，即使没有加 --shared-zlib 标志，上述步骤可能仍然会成功。

sents.en: However, later, when you attempt to npm install something using your old version of node.js, you will see incorrect data check errors.
sents.zh: 然而，之后当你尝试使用旧版本的 node.js 执行 npm install 安装某些东西时，你会看到错误的数据校验错误。

sents.en: If you want to avoid the possible hassle of dealing with this, include that flag.
sents.zh: 如果你想避免处理这个问题可能带来的麻烦，请加上该标志。

sents.en: For more details, see this issue and this comment
sents.zh: 更多详情，请参见这个 issue 和这条评论

paragraphs.en: Check to make sure the architecture is correct. x64 is the abbreviation for x86_64 , which is what you want to see.
paragraphs.zh: 检查以确保架构正确。x64 是 x86_64 的缩写，这正是你想要看到的。

paragraphs.en: $ node -p process.arch x64 Now you should be able to use node as usual.
paragraphs.zh:
$ node -p process.arch
x64

paragraphs.en: Where you can ping 8.8.8.8 while you can't ping google.com
paragraphs.zh: 你可以 ping 通 8.8.8.8 却 ping 不通 google.com 的情况

paragraphs.en: This could simply be solved by running this in your root directory:
paragraphs.zh: 只需在你的根目录下运行以下命令即可解决：

paragraphs.en: sudo rm /etc/resolv.conf sudo bash -c ' echo "nameserver 8.8.8.8" > /etc/resolv.conf ' sudo bash -c ' echo "[network]" > /etc/wsl.conf ' sudo bash -c ' echo "generateResolvConf = false" >> /etc/wsl.conf ' sudo chattr +i /etc/resolv.conf This deletes your resolv.conf file that is automatically generated when you run WSL, creates a new file and puts nameserver 8.8.8.8 , then creates a wsl.conf file and adds [network] and generateResolveConf = false to prevent auto-generation of that file.
paragraphs.zh: sudo rm /etc/resolv.conf sudo bash -c ' echo "nameserver 8.8.8.8" > /etc/resolv.conf ' sudo bash -c ' echo "[network]" > /etc/wsl.conf ' sudo bash -c ' echo "generateResolvConf = false" >> /etc/wsl.conf ' sudo chattr +i /etc/resolv.conf 这会删除你运行 WSL 时自动生成的 resolv.conf 文件，创建一个新文件并写入 nameserver 8.8.8.8，然后创建一个 wsl.conf 文件并添加 [network] 和 generateResolveConf = false，以防止该文件被自动生成。

paragraphs.en: You can check the contents of the file by running:
paragraphs.zh: 你可以通过运行以下命令来查看该文件的内容：

paragraphs.en: cat /etc/resolv.conf Maintainers Currently, the sole maintainer is @ljharb - more maintainers are quite welcome, and we hope to add folks to the team over time. Governance will be re-evaluated as the project evolves.
paragraphs.zh: cat /etc/resolv.conf 维护者 目前，唯一的维护者是 @ljharb —— 非常欢迎更多维护者加入，我们希望随着时间推移不断吸纳新成员加入团队。 随着项目的发展，治理结构将会重新评估。
